deadlines.dateText: *There are no application deadlines at EBS.** However, to ensure a smooth start to your studies, we recommend that you submit your application before 30 June (for a start in the winter semester). For international applicants who require a visa, we recommend that you submit your application before 30 May (for a start in the winter semester).
